sources.title: Prime Minister's Office Kingdom of Tonga

capital.evidence_quote: Nuku'alofa is the royal capital and seat of government of the Kingdom of Tonga on Tongatapu

currency.evidence_quote: The Tongan Paʻanga (TOP, T$) is the official currency of the Kingdom of Tonga

timezone.evidence_quote: Tonga Time operates on UTC+13 year-round, among the first nations to greet each new calendar day

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard residential supply voltage across the Kingdom is 240V 50 Hz

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: National electrical power grid operates at 50 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: Australian standard Type I three-pin angled plugs are standard throughout Tonga

police.evidence_quote: Dial 922 for emergency police response across Tongatapu, Vava'u, and Ha'apai

ambulance.evidence_quote: Call 933 for hospital emergency medical dispatch and ambulance transport

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 999 for emergency fire and rescue services

general.evidence_quote: 911 serves as an alternative unified emergency contact line

tourist_police.evidence_quote: Tourism information office in Nuku'alofa assists visitors at +676 23555

advisory_headline.tr: Tonga Krallığı son derece huzurlu ve güvenli bir Pasifik monarşisidir; standart seyahat önlemleri yeterlidir.
advisory_headline.en: The Kingdom of Tonga is very peaceful, safe, and welcoming; exercise standard travel precautions.
advisory_headline.de: Das Königreich Tonga ist ein sehr friedliches und sicheres Reiseland; normale Vorsichtsmaßnahmen genügen.
advisory_headline.ru: Королевство Тонга — мирный и безопасный тихоокеанский архипелаг; действуют обычные правила.
advisory_headline.es: El Reino de Tonga es un destino sumamente pacífico y seguro; aplican precauciones normales.

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median mobile broadband download speeds in Tonga reach approximately 22.0 Mbps

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median fixed broadband download speeds measure 35.0 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: Digicel Tonga and TCC (Tonga Communications Corporation) provide 4G SIMs at Fua'amotu International Airport (TBU). Tonga is one of the only places on Earth where humans can ethically swim with wild humpback whales in warm breeding bays (July to October in Vava'u).
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: Prepaid SIM registration requires valid passport verification

religion.value: Christianity (approx. 96%, predominantly Free Wesleyan Church of Tonga, Roman Catholic, and Mormon/LDS)
religion.evidence_quote: Christian faith and the Royal Family are the twin constitutional pillars of Tongan society

festivals.value: Heilala Festival in July (celebrating King Tupou VI's birthday with nationwide block parties), Vava'u Regatta, Kingdom Day
festivals.evidence_quote: Heilala Festival is Tonga's flagship national celebration featuring beauty pageants and traditional lakalaka dances

legal_cultural_warnings.value: Strict Sunday Sabbath is enshrined in the Tongan Constitution: all businesses, sports, and commercial flights are prohibited on Sundays. Modest dress is required in public (men and women must wear shirts and knee-length clothing in towns). Swimming without a licensed operator near humpback whales is strictly prohibited.
legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: Under the Constitution of Tonga, Sunday is kept sacred; all trade and commerce are unlawful

tipping.value: Tipping is not customary and not expected in Tonga. Outstanding service is best recognized with sincere thanks ('Mālō 'aupito').
tipping.evidence_quote: Tipping is neither customary nor expected in Tongan culture
